name: ride-attack-seat
description: D-214: (100 m out of the bed / hub no-hit ring, like attack-key-tree) while the ridden troll attacks, the rider's seat stays on the bone it hangs on (the rider does not clip through the basket).

asserts.name: stt.rideAttackFrames
asserts.label: the troll really attacked while ridden (sampled frames in an attack)

asserts.name: stt.rideAnchorGapAttack
asserts.label: the seat is on the bone during every frame of an attack (cm; the old idle easing left it 30 cm and more behind)

asserts.name: stt.rideGap
asserts.label: the rider sits exactly on the seat point in every frame (cm)

asserts.name: stt.rideSeatTiltAttack
asserts.label: T-217 R3: the seat itself leaned far during the attack (degrees; measured 91.6 and 95.0 in runs a26-t1 / a26-t2 - under 45 the swing was not a real one and the tilt gap proves nothing)

asserts.name: stt.rideTiltGapAttack
asserts.label: T-217 R3 / R10: the rider leans with the seat during the attack: at most 5 degrees between the rider's lean and the seat's lean, both measured from the standing pose at the start of the sampling (runs: 4.8, 9.4 and - with one reference for the whole measurement - 42.1 degrees at a seat lean of 116.5: the rider follows the SWING but not the pose the seat had swayed into before it; the user's verdict 2026-11-10 10:37 is that the rider must sit on the chair in every frame = FAILS until R10 is done)
